subject: Urgent: Megacorp throughput collapse after quantized-v3 rollout — coordinated fallback & comms
messages:
From: Avery Smith <avery@megacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@megacorp.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Severe latency + 5xx surge after your 'quantized-v3' push

Sean —

We started seeing a sharp rise in 5xx and 429 errors across multiple endpoints right after the model change that your team pushed at ~05:50 PT. Our production traffic spiked CPU on the sidecars and the requests that used the new quantized-v3 variant are timing out at 3s. Overall throughput for our chat endpoints has dropped ~60%.

Attached are a short trace sample and the aggregated timing CSV for the 08:00–08:10 window. Can you confirm if you rolled a config/quant/spec change for our account? This is impacting checkout flows for a handful of customers.

Avery
Platform Ops, Megacorp
[attachment: timing-sample-20261212.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx surge after your 'quantized-v3' push

Looping in runtime and SRE. Megacorp is reporting a production-wide throughput collapse with 5xx/429 shortly after we deployed quantized-v3 and a kernel tweak to the attention path for non-batched fast-paths. Immediate asks: 

1) Marissa/Karthik: can you confirm whether Megacorp was included in the quantized-v3 rollout (config exposure) or if they received a kernel change?
2) If yes, start an emergency canary-fallback to the previous quantized profile (quantized-v2) for Megacorp only. Prioritize minimal disruption (route by customer tag).
3) SRE: increase telemetry retention for their bucket and open an incident channel — include token-level latency and 429/5xx breakdowns.
4) Hannah/Laura: prepare a short external note for Avery that includes expected mitigation ETA and which fallbacks we'll run. Keep comms to a single thread and set expectation: we will avoid a full account rollback unless fallback fails.

I'll be on the incident channel while you triage. If kernel mismatch is confirmed, we should also capture a sample VM with the kernel+lib versions to reproduce.

—Sean
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx surge after your 'quantized-v3' push

Investigating now. Short summary of findings so far from the first 20 minutes: 
- We rolled quantized-v3 to 30% of traffic with a targeted kernel change for the attention fast-path at 05:50 PT. Megacorp was on the 30% cohort via their feature tag.
- Error pattern: 429 spikes correlate with long tail queue wait times in the GPU worker pool; 5xx stack traces show a kernel fallback path that throws at kv-cache load when sequence lengths exceed internal thresholds.
- Hypothesis: the new kernel's path for short sequences is triggering a path that does an expensive validation on certain prompt shapes (Megacorp uses many short, high-frequency prompts). That validation plus continuous retries is creating a retry storm.

Immediate actions (in progress):
- Starting customer-scoped rollback (quantized-v2) now for Megacorp. Expected completion: 12 minutes.
- Disabling the attention-path kernel flag for that cohort to prevent the expensive validation path.
- Increasing per-connection queue depth timeouts to reduce incidental 429s while rollback completes.

Will post a confirmation when traffic normalizes and attach the collected logs.

—Marissa
Lead Runtime Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Ops Team <ops@megacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Smith <avery@megacorp.com>, platform-team@megacorp.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx surge after your 'quantized-v3' push

Thanks — we see a partial recovery already. 429 rate dropped ~45% in the last 5 minutes, but a residual 5xx tail remains. We're attaching a more complete log bundle, including a snippet showing the kv-cache error trace you noted.

[attachment: megacorp-requested-logs.zip (zip, 18MB)]

Please let us know once you have the rollback fully in place and we can validate end-to-end. We'll hold off on scaling changes from our side until you confirm baseline restored.

—Megacorp Platform Team

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency + 5xx surge after your 'quantized-v3' push

Rollback to quantized-v2 completed for Megacorp at 09:02 PT (routing delta confirmed). Observed metrics post-rollback: 
- Successful throughput returned to ~92% of baseline within 5 minutes.
- 429 rate reduced to pre-deploy baseline.
- Residual 5xxs are primarily from a small set of requests that hit the validation path and had been retried aggressively; those are tapering.

Next steps:
- Capture a memory/coredump sample from a failing worker for offline repro. Marissa: can you request the job snapshot from the node where the kv-cache exception occurred (node id included in the logs)?
- We should schedule a paused-canary re-roll with additional tracing and a stricter sequence-length guard for the validation path. No resume to broad traffic until we add the guard.

—Karthik
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Smith <avery@megacorp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Update: mitigation applied and next steps

Avery —

Thanks for your patience and for sending the logs. Quick summary of what we did and what to expect: 

- We immediately scoped a customer-only rollback from quantized-v3 -> quantized-v2; routing change completed at 09:02 PT.
- We disabled the new attention-family kernel flag for your cohort.
- We've increased request-level timeouts and suppressed automatic client retries temporarily to avoid amplifying the tail.

Current status: latency and 429 rates are back to expected levels; residual 5xxs are tailing off. We will continue to monitor your traffic for 24 hours and will provide hourly updates until you confirm stability.

Planned follow-ups (this week):
- Joint postmortem with Megacorp ops + runtime team to walk through the kernel validation path and add a sequence-length guard (action owner: Marissa).
- Engineering change: add more conservative canary gating and an automatic rollback trigger for per-customer regressions.

If you need an exec touchpoint, we can set a 15-minute sync today with Sean and our Head of Product.

—Hannah
VP, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
